title: Quantifying the drug response of patient-derived organoid clusters by aggregated morphological indicators with multi-parameters based on optical coherence tomography.
summary: EGO-Net segmented OCT images and quantified organoid morphology; PCA aggregated longitudinal indicators correlated >0.90 with ATP viability tests in colorectal cancer organoids from three patients, and response varied across drug doses/combinations. Full Methods/Results read. Very small in-vitro sample; no claim of patient treatment benefit.
